decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's line opens a new segment for a firm with a narrow range. There is no evidence since 2019 that its value has failed to materialize, and a certified natural cosmetics line costs little to keep on the market, so the option is still worth more than its carrying cost.

The cleansing foam extends the existing Sandorini series, so it shares production and branding and costs very little to carry. Nothing shows that its value has resolved negatively, which makes keeping it the sensible choice.
